Challenges and potential activities: Every statement was checked against text fetched with curl and converted with pdftotext or an HTML-to-text script. The main sources are the 2018 creation decree, the 2021 IMET management-effectiveness sheet published by OFAC, two 2025 peer-reviewed studies (Forests, on mangrove cover change 1980–2022; VertigO, on artisanal fishing with 2024 fieldwork), and Global Voices reports from 2024 and 2025. Sources disagree on the park's size: the decree and IMET give 262,935 ha, the 2019 CWCS report gives about 300,000 ha, and Global Voices gives an erroneous '2,630 hectares'. The decree figure is used. Wikidata item Q1251334 is labelled 'Douala-Edéa National Park', is an instance of national park in Cameroon, and has coordinates (3.5°N, 9.83°E) inside the park; its inception date (1932) is the reserve's.
